mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO public.nocode_biz_file_retention (file_id, holder_type, holder_id, object_id, record_id, creator, updater) VALUES
(#{fileId}, #{holderType}, #{holderId}, #{objectId}, #{recordId}, #{actor}, #{actor})
ON CONFLICT (file_id, holder_type, holder_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.file_id FROM public.nocode_biz_file_retention r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.file_id IN #{fileId} AND ( r.holder_type <> 'WORK_DRAFT' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_work_draft d WHERE d.id = r.holder_id AND d.state = 'DRAFT' AND d.deleted = 0 ) )
